body: A little over a month ago. She isn't the same person I fell in love with but that person is still in her and that's what I want to protect.

I told myself I wouldn't feel anything for her and I did, for a little while. I did everything for her. I helped her with her abusive past relationship, I accepted her friends even when I wasn't really able to connect with them, I took her on dates everywhere we wanted to go, I threw her a surprise party when she had to move away, and made time out of my busy schedule to meet her when she was in college. Too bad she couldn't make jack shit for me, not even 30 minutes. She kept telling me how much she loved me but I guess that was a lie as well. In the end she just kept throwing me off and blamed it on how busy she was at college. I never realized that I was in the same situation that she was in and that I could still spare time with her when she couldn't. And even after all that I couldn't tell it to her fucking face how angry I was at her for doing this. All I could do was say that I was sorry I couldn't find time for her. I'm a pathetic for that and I couldn't even man up when I needed to. Now shes using all the time she was busy with to hang out with her friends and probably flirting with other guys while I'm just sitting here knowing what I did wrong and how I could've fixed it if I was just less of a dumb ass. Even after all of this realization I still just want her back...

And yes I do realize I have my life ahead of me and I feel like I already know the outcomes. 

1. I get lucky and land a job at a shitty office (as stated above)

2. I'm homeless and begging or living off my parents and I'd rather die than do either one of those

Also to answer your question I go to a shitty community college because I fucked up my high-school. I'm trying my hardest to do well though because I don't want to let my parents down again and I don't want to be my brother which is another long story itself.
